name: Gardener's Orchard and Bakery
description: Gardener's Orchard and Bakery grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Blackberries, Apples, and Peaches in Brighton, MO. The farm is working, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
